new_evidence_vs_previous: NFCorpus adds a separate retrieval dataset to previous SciFact188; MoleculeACE adds30 official tasks to previous LPAR1/PDE4B input-repair evaluation. No rerun of the previous experiments.

retrieval.method: Adopted MedCPT bi-encoder representations and exact dot scores; unchanged native token and source validation rules. Native CPU workers copied with explicit CUDA placement for this offline evaluation, two chunks merged globally.
retrieval.baseline: Fixed BM25 k1=1.2,b=0.75,lowercase alphanumeric tokens,unique query terms,positive Lucene IDF; not a Pyserini leaderboard reproduction.
retrieval.ci: Paired bootstrap over323 queries,2000 repetitions,seed20261002; related queries may be dependent.
retrieval.runtime_scope: Offline GPU0 evaluation, not deployed CPU search latency; allocator cap2GiB, actual total GPU peak not measured.
retrieval.adopted_role: Optional semantic relevance ordering of retained source documents; scientific strength and efficacy ranking remain separate.
limits: Relevance labels do not assess truth, clinical efficacy or end-to-end answer accuracy.
Author pretraining exposure to benchmark documents is not excluded.
Full author cross-encoder reranker is not evaluated.

activity_prediction.scale: pKi/pEC50 =9-log10(nM), each task separate; native training labels rounded to3 decimal places, external gold unrounded.
activity_prediction.estimator: RF300,min_samples_leaf2,seed20260930,Morgan radius2/2048bits/chirality; native scaffold split inside official train; no tuning.
activity_prediction.baseline: Mean of actual native inner-training labels, separately for every task.
activity_prediction.adopted_role: Conditioned activity predictions only when the native inner-scaffold gate passes; generated structures remain unmeasured.
limits: Official test is not entirely new scaffold chemistry.
Benchmark aggregate means do not establish equivalence of original assays/species/protocols.
Fixed one-seed evaluation against a training-mean baseline; not a SOTA comparison.
Two official tasks share one ChEMBL target ID; other targets may also be related.
Measured activity prediction does not validate generated-compound activity, safety or clinical benefit.
